tier_definitions.HIGH_RELIABILITY: Narrow calibrated prediction interval (relative width <= 0.65), IN_DISTRIBUTION feature space, and high attribution stability.
tier_definitions.MODERATE_RELIABILITY: Standard calibrated interval, mild distribution shifts (NEAR_OOD), or moderate seasonal variability.
tier_definitions.HIGH_UNCERTAINTY: Wide interval (relative width > 0.85), OUT_OF_DISTRIBUTION input, or extreme severe episode with elevated variance.
